risk_summary.quantity_basis: gross held positions; pending orders not netted

positions.thesis: RTX is a commercial-aerospace and defense backlog-conversion position. Collins, Pratt & Whitney, and Raytheon must turn a $289 billion backlog into durable organic growth and free cash flow while supply-chain disruption, fixed-price execution, and the GTF powder-metal fleet plan stay controlled.
A development-stage bet on Project Matador becoming a scarce, gigawatt-scale powered AI campus. Commercial agreements and funded delivery—not headline capacity—must validate it.

RoboStrategy is a closed-end private-robotics access position. Monthly NAV growth and portfolio-company financing or liquidity events must outrun the stock's premium to Level 3 marks, a 2.50% management fee on gross assets, dilution, and weak price discovery.

AeroVironment is a defense-autonomy and unmanned-systems backlog-conversion position. BlueHalo integration, funded orders, and supply-chain execution must turn fiscal 2026's acquisition-led scale into durable organic growth, margins, and cash flow.
Financial-sector leadership plus Robinhood growth and a rising blockchain-fee thesis.

Planet's daily Earth-imagery archive can compound into a recurring geospatial-data platform as defense, intelligence, and sovereign demand grows; Pelican execution and backlog conversion must outrun launch risk, capital intensity, and dilution.

SpaceX is a vertically integrated launch, connectivity, and AI-infrastructure position. Starship progress, Starlink scale, and contracted AI compute must convert exceptional growth into durable cash economics while capital intensity, execution, regulation, acquisition risk, and governance stay controlled.

Kopin is a speculative defense-optics and microdisplay position. Government-funded MicroLED development, defense programs, and prototype wins must convert into product revenue and sustainable profitability before litigation, concentration, cash needs, or execution consume the upside.

NVIDIA is an AI-compute platform position. Vera Rubin production and accelerating inference demand must convert a $108 billion Q3 revenue outlook into durable growth and cash generation while supply commitments, China restrictions, customer concentration, and elevated expectations stay controlled.
